caption: The drawing depicts a single, large ceramic jug placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The jug is tan or light brown in color and has a cylindrical shape that bulges slightly outward at the middle and tapers toward the top, with a wide, rounded rim. There are two small, ear-shaped handles attached symmetrically on either side near the upper part of the jug. Toward the upper center of the jug’s body, there is a dark blue painted motif resembling the number "3" or a stylized marking. Below this, on the rounded part of the jug, there is a larger, dark blue decorative illustration of a rooster facing to the left. The jug’s surface appears smooth with subtle shading indicating light and form. The inside of the jug is dark, with an almost black appearance. There is a faint signature or writing near the lower right of the drawing, as well as some small pencil or ink notes. The backdrop is plain and does not introduce any additional objects or colors.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
